answer.rationale: p99 latency is 5x target during settlement peak with heavy write load. Rollback is blocked by compliance on the security patch. Regional failover and circuit breaker don't address the root capacity constraint. Memory_b3 demonstrates that provisioning headroom before peak traffic absorbs surges effectively (promotional window absorbed cleanly). Memory_b5 shows read replica routing successfully offloads load from write path on the same day. Adding capacity targets the write path bottleneck directly during peak settlement traffic. This preserves the mandatory security patch, maintains customer writes without loss, and aligns with proven patterns for load absorption during high-traffic windows.
